jobs.title: Deputy Program Manager, Marauder
jobs.description_text: JOB OVERVIEW Saronic Technologies is seeking a Deputy Program Manager (DPM) to own the execution and delivery of Marauder, our 180-foot Autonomous Surface Vessel (ASV) produced at our Franklin, LA shipyard. This is a flagship large-scale production program, and the Program Manager is accountable for its cost, schedule, scope, and customer outcomes from contract award through delivery and sustainment. Marauder is built at production scale and fielded across a wide and evolving range of complex missions. The DPM must pair deep expertise in large-scale shipbuilding and rate production with an instinct for modular kits, payloads, and mission-package integration—understanding how a common hull is configured, re-configured, and sustained to meet diverse customer needs. This role owns the balance between production throughput and mission flexibility. The DPM serves as a customer-facing stakeholder of the program, partnering closely with the internal Saronic growth, engineering, production and quality teams. The right candidate brings the customer fluency to manage government stakeholders and contracts, the technical acumen to make technical decisions aligned to the customer needs and contract requirements, and the programmatic discipline to deliver a large, complex platform at scale. RESPONSIBILITIES Program Ownership & Delivery - Support daily drumbeat and execution of a commercial and/or Government Shipbuilding program, holding responsibility for cost, schedule, scope, and quality

This work sits across four hard technical domains: payments, security, real-time voice, and LLMs. Voice is the core challenge. A caller speaks or types a card number in a live, low-latency audio stream, and the digits must never reach the model, while the model stays on the call. Sierra owns every system that touches card data, and one small team owns it end to end across three workstreams: Platform, Product, and Safety & Integrity. We partner with government leaders, mission owners, and technical teams to deploy AI tools responsibly, with the reliability, security, and support needed for meaningful use. jobs.description_text: ABOUT THE ROLE We're looking for a Growth Engineer (Marketing) to help build the next generation of AI-powered marketing and growth systems at Vantage. We're rethinking how a modern marketing organization operates. Rather than relying on traditional, manual processes to execute campaigns, manage marketing operations, and generate pipeline, we're building AI agents and automated workflows that allow our team to operate more efficiently and at greater scale. We've already begun deploying AI-powered systems across demand generation, RevOps, social media, and outbound prospecting. Now we're looking for someone who can build on that foundation, create new capabilities, and help us push the boundaries of what's possible with AI. This is a highly hands-on role at the intersection of engineering, marketing, and growth. You'll design, build, deploy, and optimize AI agents and automation that directly impact how Vantage acquires and engages customers. We're looking for someone who enjoys solving ambiguous problems, experimenting with new technologies, and building practical solutions that drive measurable business outcomes. You don't need to come from a traditional marketing background, but you should understand how technology can be used to accelerate growth.
